result.summary: Found 2 issues: the bottom restaurant card is partially obscured by the bottom navigation bar, and a card name is truncated in the horizontal carousel.

issues.description: The second card under 'Popular right now' (the -20% pizza card) is cut off/overlapped by the bottom navigation bar, hiding its name, rating, and delivery info
issues.suggestion: Add bottom padding to the scrollable content area so cards can scroll fully clear of the bottom navigation bar

issues.description: Restaurant name 'Trattoria Piccol' is truncated with the card cut off at the screen edge in the 'Fastest near you' carousel
issues.suggestion: This is expected for horizontal scrolling, but consider adding a visual peek/gradient hint or allowing text to wrap so the truncation is clearly discoverable
